name: Shopware
description: Shopware is an open-source e-commerce platform built on Symfony and Vue.js. It offers a headless Store API, a Twig storefront, rule-based pricing and promotions, and an extension system for plugins, apps and themes.

notes.text: The admin login is saved to ~/shopware.creds inside the container. The Administration is at /admin.
If the shop moves to a domain or sits behind a reverse proxy, update APP_URL in /opt/shopware/.env.local and the sales channel domain in the Administration.
Major Shopware upgrades (e.g. 6.7 to 6.8) are not applied by the update and must follow the official upgrade guide.

app_vars.name: var_opensearch
app_vars.label: Install OpenSearch
app_vars.help: OpenSearch for storefront and admin search; without it search runs on MariaDB
